versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02037 When an I-PDU is transmitted because of the function Com_TriggerIPDUSend or Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData , the AUTOSAR COM module shall only take the minimum delay time into account. That is the AUTOSAR COM module shall post- pone transmissions if necessary and reset the minimum delay timer in case of transmis- sions. The AUTOSAR COM module shall not take into account all other transmission mode related parameters like ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions .
